ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure 4, there is a wax block in a vertically placed glass tube. When the wax block rises uniformly from the bottom end of the glass tube, the glass tube moves uniformly horizontally to the right, until the wax block rises to the top end of the glass tube. Regarding the motion of the wax block, which of the following statements is correct? (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: The trajectory of the wax block is a straight line.

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: The trajectory of the wax block is a straight line.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, it can be seen that the vertical glass tube appears at different positions from left to right, indicating that the glass tube is moving to the right; the position of the black wax block inside the tube changes from the bottom in the left figure, to a higher position in the middle figure, and then to a position near the top end in the right figure, showing that the wax block moves upward in the tube, while at the same time the whole moves to the right with the glass tube. Then reason: The question stem states that the wax block rises uniformly from the bottom end relative to the glass tube, and the glass tube also moves uniformly horizontally to the right. Let the horizontal velocity of the glass tube be v_x, and the vertical rising velocity of the wax block relative to the glass tube be v_y. Then the horizontal displacement of the wax block relative to the ground satisfies x=v_x t, and the vertical displacement satisfies y=v_y t. Eliminating time t gives y=(v_y/v_x)x, that is, the vertical displacement is proportional to the horizontal displacement. Therefore, the motion trajectory of the wax block relative to the ground is a straight line. Final answer: The trajectory of the wax block is a straight line.
